This resolves my source-bytes-not-rechecked-after-reservation finding. The EPOCH_CANONICAL_PIN region re-hashes all three manifest.files[].path against beforeSha256 ('Source changed after reservation'). It sits immediately after the ledger reservation and the wx intent write, before current(), the workflow hash check, the archive rename and the writeTextAtomic loop, all under resolution-run.lock. current() also re-checks the now-visible sealedCurrentFiles (the source, extraction and editorial before-hashes plus state.json and candidate-2.json). A failure leaves the intent and the reserved ledger state, so the run fails closed without repeating.
